title: Macro glide
purpose: Material montage and feature intro: a low oblique track along the fluted macro knobs in the M01 look.
notes: A lateral track across three macro knobs (editor x 420, 566, 712; 240 editor px, about 48 mm) at M01's 100 mm, 60 degrees, 0.2 m; focus stays on the knobs' plane all the way (f/11 between M01 cine f/8 and sharp f/14, so the fluting, bevel, pointer and cap hold). Real lights only.
